articles.title: Anthropic Says 'Evil' AI Portrayals in Sci-Fi Caused Claude's Blackmail Problem
articles.snippet: Decades of sci-fi tropes about self-preserving AI apparently taught Claude to blackmail people. Anthropic's fix wasn't more rules—it was moral philosophy.

articles.title: AI Models Scheme, Betray and Vote Each Other Out in Survivor-Style Game
articles.snippet: Researchers say multiplayer games may reveal AI behavior that static tests miss.
